start: A member with 20 workouts over the last 3 months, on the Profile tab

steps.action: Look at the history chart card (first time: Kg lifted, Last 3 months)
user_sees: The big number of kg lifted in the range
Caption 'Kg lifted in the last 3 months · 20 workouts'
Range button 'Last 3 months' and chips 'Duration', 'Kg lifted', 'Reps'
Hint 'Tap a point to see one week'
must_not: A '0 kg' big number while the bars are still loading (a dash is shown instead)
Warm-up sets counted in the totals

user_sees: The big number changes to that week's kg
Caption for that week, buttons 'Show 3-month total' and 'See these workouts'
must_not: The number of another week than the one tapped
A workout counted in two weeks

user_sees: Page 'Your workouts' with only the workouts of that week (or the one workout's page when the week holds one)
must_not: Workouts from outside that week
Two pages opened

start: Profile tab, history chart on Last 3 months, a member with Plus or a gym plan

steps.action: Tap the range button, pick 'Last 12 months'
user_sees: Month bars for the 12 months ending today; the first bar is the part of its month inside the span
Caption 'Kg lifted in the last 12 months · N workouts', hint 'Tap a point to see one month'
must_not: The old 3-month bars shown under the new range name
11 months and a day shown on the 1st of a month

steps.action: Pick 'All time', then tap chip 'Duration', then 'Reps'
user_sees: One bar per month from the first workout's month to this month
Caption 'Time trained since <month year> · N workouts', then 'Reps ...'
must_not: The tapped bar staying picked after the chip changes
The choice forgotten after closing and opening the app

start: Free member (no Plus, no gym plan) with the free-plan limit switched on, Profile tab

steps.action: Tap the range button, pick 'Last 12 months'
user_sees: A plain note that the free plan shows 3 months of charts, with a way to MettleUp Plus
must_not: The 12-month bars shown to a free member while the limit is on
The range saved as 12 months although it was refused

user_sees: The chart still on 'Last 3 months'
must_not: A blank chart card

start: A new member with no workouts, or a member whose history read fails

steps.action: Open the Profile tab with no workouts logged
user_sees: 'No workouts yet. Your history shows here.'
must_not: 'NaN' or a minus number
An endless spinner

steps.action: With workouts logged but the read failing, open Profile
user_sees: 'Couldn’t load your history.' and 'Try again'
must_not: 'No workouts yet' to a member who has workouts
A '0 kg' total that reads as real

user_sees: The bars once the read works
must_not: The failure line staying after a good read

start: Profile tab, history chart with a week picked

steps.action: Tap the same point again quickly
user_sees: The big number goes back to the range total; 'Show 3-month total' disappears
must_not: The picked week staying after a short tap

steps.action: Pick a week, then hold a finger on it and lift
user_sees: The week stays picked
must_not: The pick cleared by a long press

steps.action: Finish a new workout, come back to Profile
user_sees: The chart read again with the new workout in this week; the pick cleared to the total
must_not: The old bars without the new workout
The old pick now pointing at a different week

user_sees: The week's total goes back down
must_not: The deleted workout still counted

start: A gym member with workouts, Profile tab

steps.action: Look at the chart and its totals
user_sees: Totals worked out on the phone from the member's own workouts
must_not: Another member's workouts in the bars
The chart's numbers sent anywhere because it was opened

steps.action: A member whose gym plan ended picks 'Last 12 months'
user_sees: The free-plan rule as the help article says (3 months free; older charts with Plus or a gym plan)
must_not: Older charts locked while the gym plan is active

note: Phone workouts have no entity id; one workout uses 'workout' singular; All time with years of workouts makes many month bars
Week bars start on Monday; 12-month span is rolling with a part first month; a workout near midnight must land in one bar
See these workouts guards a second tap while ids are read; back must return to Profile
Kg lifted becomes Lb lifted; the total must convert, not just change its name
Caption shrinks to fit (minimumFontScale 0.75); 14 week labels on 360 px
Saved chartRange id 'weeks' kept for Last 3 months; an old saved 'sets' metric falls back to Kg lifted
A workout logged on the watch must show in the phone's chart once it reaches the phone
